answer: Each identity needs one relic: a verified job sealed in the karst archive, mineralizing ten epochs. A fresh identity earns nothing until its relic fossilizes; sealed to one key, a bought relic voids itself and burns the buyer. Each identity locks 60 and pays 25 per job for three jobs. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 135 = 135,000 against a 40,000 pool, net loss 95,000. Once fossilized, a lotus mark unlocks the full share; an honest agent pays once.
